result.title: Predictive Closure: A Set-Level Characterization of JEPA's Feature Selection
result.summary: In joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPA), an encoder and a predictor are trained together to produce a representation that minimizes the error in predicting the representation of the next observation. Because the representations of both the current and the next observation are learned, it is unclear which features they will include. Earlier characterizations describe the features JEPA selects in terms of their individual predictability, raising the concern that unpredictable features, like a traffic light, will not be encoded into the representation. However, the prediction error is also affected by the relationships between features, e.g., the light's color helps predict whether the traffic will stop. We propose the predictive closure characterization, which accounts for these relationships. Based on a reformulation of the JEPA training objective, we show that selection depends on properties of feature sets. This view agrees with earlier works when features evolve independently, but makes new predictions when they do not, for instance that a feature like the traffic light can still be retained. We test this characterization in controlled experiments, which show that unpredictable features can become better represented when they help predict other features, and that changing one feature's predictive relationships can affect how well others are represented. We also demonstrate implications for steering feature selection: targeting one feature with an auxiliary objective, or supplying it to the predictor as side information, can strengthen the representation of another feature whose future values it helps predict, so steering can be indirect.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对 JEPA 中「表示会编码哪些特征」的问题，提出集合级的 predictive closure 刻画：通过重构训练目标说明特征选择取决于特征集合间的预测关系而非单个特征自身的可预测性，并用受控实验验证，进而展示可通过辅助目标或 side information 间接引导特征被表示。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「哪些特征因有助于预测他者而被保留」的集合级判据，可供核查能否用于分析 VLM latent 状态中视觉细节的留存与信息坍缩；将特征作为 side information 送入 predictor 的观察也可能为视觉旁路设计提供线索，但迁移性尚待验证。
